observations: Two industrial machines on casters side by side on a tiled floor
Left machine has an overhead control panel with a dial, a vertical press mechanism, and a blue cabinet base with a beige panel
Right machine has an open side panel, a visible chain drive inside, and a blue cabinet base with a grid of push buttons
No readable brand or model on either machine in either photo
A warning label is visible on the right machine but the text is unreadable
Watermark 'SEGUN ODESINA' appears across both photos

claims.claim: machine is in top working condition
claims.evidence: photos show the exterior only; no operation is demonstrated

claims.claim: company just invested in a fully automated system
claims.evidence: seller's statement about their company; not visible or provable from the photos

risks.proof: video of the machine running under load
close-up of the motor, bearings, and moving parts
complete inventory shot including manuals and tools

risks.risk: electrical voltage or phase incompatible with local supply
risks.proof: photo of the nameplate showing voltage and phase

proof_requests: Video of the machine operating through a full cycle
Close-up photo of any nameplate or brand label
Photo showing voltage, phase, and power requirements
Demonstration that all buttons and controls function
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an industrial machine by type even though no brand or model is readable, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working.
